items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: No I knew Dede Butler. He used to play the accordion.

ctx.x: Well that's still happening today in colleges and schools.

Well he played for the Buzzards for years, the Jefferson City Buzzards, every Mardi Gras. For a long time he had Archie Robinson and Booker T is the bass drum player, you know him, Henry Clash? And Dede Pierce, the trumpet player? That's right. You know Billy and Dede, do you know them? I don't know. No I knew Dede Butler. He used to play the accordion. Where's he from? New Orleans? New Orleans?
Who did he play with? Well that was the fellow that used to, you know the add-on when you didn't have nobody, you see?
